title: Underline the map list's text link and keep the Create a Space progressbar off the Start over button

source.ref: Visual sweep 2026-11-02 axe crawl (wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21aa) on 62 public routes at 1280x900: link-in-text-block on /, /spaces, /stories; nested-interactive on /create-a-space

detail:
Two serious axe findings on the public site. The What's happening map list shows 'Nothing is on the calendar yet. Host the first one.' with the link told apart by colour only (WCAG 1.4.1); it is now underlined in body ink. The Create a Space meter put role=progressbar on the block that also holds the Start over button, so a control sat inside a progressbar (WCAG 4.1.2); the role and its aria-value attributes moved to the ring that draws the percentage. The other axe hits on main were the /themes comparison tables (handed to the theme pages thread) and the contrast of a scaled site preview marked role=img, which is a picture of the Space's own kit colours, not UI text.

 Fixed 2026-11-02; axe re-run: / and /spaces clean, /create-a-space down to the preview picture's own contrast.
